text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the cafeteria, I found Nishino Flower
with a large assortment of traditional Japanese sweets laid out.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
That's an incredible amount of snacks, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone from the shopping district handed this to me, saying,
"Eat a lot and grow big!"...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can eat it all...
Still, it was so kind of them, so I have to
eat properly and grow big and strong...
choice_data_list: Eating well is essential for growth.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true, isn't it...
Potted flowers will wither if you give them too much water, too...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I won't eat it all at once,
I'll enjoy a little bit each day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Nishino Flower accepted their kindness without overexerting herself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll do my best to eat plenty,
and make everyone say, "Look how big you've gotten!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
First, I want to be tall enough to write
on the blackboard without standing on a stool...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Nishino Flower ate everything they kindly offered in one go.
